content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: The \"Trades\" span on the ir swap screen does not navigate or show any state change when clicked. Each session repeats that click several times (S14f12e28 events 15, 41, 47; Sbcf08aaa events 45, 51, 83; Sceba0a12 events 42, 48) with no navigation between them. The page only changes after a click on the Trades menuitem (S14f12e28 event 56, Sbcf08aaa event 92, Sceba0a12 event 58), which shows a coverage overlay (61:w62, 97:w104, 63:w77) and then the ir swap navigation (app:6, app:8, app:6).", "fix": "Fix: On the \"ir swap\" screen, make the \"Trades\" span in the Hedging menu (the element clicked at about x=125, y=25) either open its submenu or navigate on click, or give it a visible pending state, so the user is not sent to the separate Trades menuitem (x=225, y=50) to get a response.", "cited_event_ids": ["15", "41", "47", "45", "51", "83", "42", "48", "56", "61:w62", "app:6", "92", "97:w104", "app:8", "58", "63:w77"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["Whether the Trades span has a click handler at all, or whether its handler fails silently", "The contents of the overlay shown before navigation (coverage events carry no content)", "Whether the delay between clicks is caused by the page or by the user's own pacing", "Browser or network timing for the navigation that follows the menuitem click"]}
